test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence that has a spelling error.

A- Keeping cities clean and free of germs is particularly essential for keeping their residents healthy.

B- Our health depends not just on our nutrition and personal hygeine but also on how we clean our cities and surroundings.

C- The spread of various diseases is intricately linked to the deteriorating state of public health condition.

D- The good news is that waste management, to keep cities clean, is now getting attention through the Swachh Bharat Mission.

options.text: The good news is that waste management, to keep cities clean, is now getting attention through the Swachh Bharat Mission.
The spread of various diseases is intricately linked to the deteriorating state of public health condition.
Keeping cities clean and free of germs is particularly essential for keeping their residents healthy.
Our health depends not just on our nutrition and personal hygeine but also on how we clean our cities and surroundings.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word with a spelling error is "**hygeine**".
 
• "**Hygeine**" is a misspelling and does not have a meaning or a Hindi translation.
 
 
• **Example (Incorrect): **Personal hygeine is important for good health. (This sentence contains the misspelled word and does not convey the intended meaning accurately.)
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is "hygiene".
 
• "**Hygiene**" means the conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease, especially through cleanliness.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **Option 4**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option** **1**: "Keeping cities clean and free of germs is particularly essential for keeping their residents healthy." This sentence is correctly spelled. 
 
• **Option 2**: "The spread of various diseases is intricately linked to the deteriorating state of public health condition." This sentence is correctly spelled.
 
• **Option 3**: "The good news is that waste management, to keep cities clean, is now getting attention through the Swachh Bharat Mission." This sentence is correctly spelled.
